1. Compute the radius r from sigma and truncate.
2. Build the 1D weights g_i for i from -r to r and divide them by their sum.
3. Pad each row with the border mode and filter it with the weights.
4. Pad each column of that result and filter it with the same weights.
5. Round to 8 bits. Keep alpha unchanged.
